surface_mechanism_description: Zr(NEt2)4 easily decomposes on Si(100) even below 300°C but Si(OnBu)4 does not decompose at 400°C. However, Si(OnBu)4 was reacted to grow silicate films in the presence of small amounts of Zr(NEt2)4. These reactivity differences of precursors and catalytic effects may induce more incorporation of Zr* than Si* in the initial steps.
evidence: Zr(NEt2)4 easily decomposes on Si(100) even below 300°C but Si(OnBu)4 does not decompose at 400°C. However, Si(OnBu)4 was reacted to grow silicate films in the presence of small amounts of Zr(NEt2)4. From these results, we believe that Zr metal catalyzes the C-O bond scission of Si(OnBu)4. These reactivity differences of precursors and catalytic effects may induce more incorporation of Zr* than Si* in the initial steps.
